purpose: Upstream provenance for every tree under lib/. Finding L11 of spec 0075: the vendored copies carried no machine-readable ref, so 'is this current, and what did we patch?' could only be answered by reading each tree. Each entry names the upstream project, the release or commit the copy tracks, and where that ref is asserted inside the tree so a bump that forgets one half is visible. A null ref is an honest unknown, not an omission.
regenerate: By hand, when a vendored tree is bumped. Update the tree's own version marker in the same commit.
